device: dedicated Android16 API36 ARM64 emulator-5584; not target tablet

instrumentation.note: Full candidate gate on the release-critical classes. DocumentNavigationTest's two long-press popup cases are excluded because they reproduce identically on the 1.2.0 baseline APK in this emulator state; both raw failures are retained in the session log and are not attributed to 1.2.1. New suites included: AbbreviationLookupTest 7, SenseDomainRankingTest 7, InkFountainPenTest 11, InkPerformanceTest 4, InkAcceptanceComparisonTest 1, DictionarySearchUpgradeTest 13.

contextDomains.note: authored probes only; not an accuracy benchmark

apk.transport: local loopback HTTP only; never uploaded

updateChannel: unchanged; latest public release remains v1.2.0 (https://github.com/dpan538/Annota/releases/tag/v1.2.0)
knownLimitations: P1 first-frame cost increases ~25-90% because the page Picture is recorded (software canvas); steady-state frames improve 2-2.9x. Hardware-layer benefit still needs device measurement.
P3 fountain v5 has no multi-point tail replay at ACTION_UP; release taper depends on the final pressure drop. Single-dot cap is ~72% of v4 by design.
Abbreviation/initialism candidates only surface with context evidence; unknown acronyms with no context fall back to ordinary word lookup.
Domain labels are coarse lexfiles: cell battery/spreadsheet/prison cannot be separated by domain alone.
Reverse zh-en entries are machine-merged; not individually proofread.
Emulator results do not replace Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max handwriting, frame-rate, thermal or memory acceptance.
